dct_description_sm:
This layer supports the implementation of the provincial legislation (ERO #025-0463) passed in November 2025, which permits as-of-right variations from setback requirements (within 10%) on urban residential lands. Certain properties are excepted from these variations, specifically those located:

  • Within 300 metres of a railway corridor
  • Within 120 metres of wetlands
  • Within 120 metres of major water features (Lake Ontario, St. Lawrence River, Great Cataraqui River)

The layer includes screening buffers for these exceptions:

  • CNR Railway Line Buffer – 300m
  • Wetland Buffer – 120m (from Schedule 7 OP Wetland features)
  • Shoreline Buffer – 120m inland from Lake Ontario, St. Lawrence River, and Great Cataraqui River
